response: The shelf doesn't rank your jazz improvisation. It notes that the culture round the texts wants to display and compare — treat the doing as a thing one has — while the texts themselves speak of the practice and the responsibilities. Your improvisation is practice, not a possession to be ranked. (as modern spiritual culture (our own description) has it)

evidence.claim: 'Spirituality' as, in modern hands, a thing one HAS - displayed, compared, ranked - is an observation about the culture round the texts, not a datum out of any of them: the texts speak of the practice and the responsibilities; the culture speaks of the status; family and work remain, and no text on this shelf says they do not.

analysis.caution_text: One caution, named once, plainly: the human boundary.
